crossRefs.note: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.
Better is the poor who walks in his integrity, than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
But godliness with contentment is great gain.
Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced…
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…
I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.
He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver; nor he who loves abundance, with increase: this also is vanity.

translations.web: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
translations.bsb: Better a little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure with turmoil.
translations.kjv: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble
translations.asv: Better is little, with the fear of Jehovah, Than great treasure and trouble therewith.
